directorFindings.finding: DR184-B03 is an external acquired-full-turn witness gap, not an unresolved Doom rule. DR9-Q04 expressly preserves the original clock through extra turns; the future obligation demands the five-pulse and initiative branches, all retained. Director explicitly qualifies the external positive-turn demonstration under Q22B; no source is invented.

DR184-B02 conflated a selectable participant choice with missing cosmology. Q14 explicitly offers willingness or advance consent. The current healing contract permits a same willing identity in its viable original body. New bounded ordinary fixtures record consent, actual death, reaffirmation/refusal and complete state settlement. No soul ownership or exceptional Hunt release is invented.

The native promise authorizes the spell-local token rule, so no further generic permission to design that rule is required. It does not establish that a particular missing soul/custody/lifecycle input is capture-eligible. Q12 expressly requires positive lawful capture without inventing availability. The prior ordinary bodies carry UNKNOWN soul availability. Those specific positive witnesses remain unproved; no token is fabricated.

Hunt admission, unknown exotic bodies/souls, absent companion phases and hypothetical persistent lethal-source histories remain conditional external inputs, not generic vetoes on the ordinary complete procedure. Existing SH-T05/SH-T18 establish the applicable denial once Hunt is actually active; they do not grant a new Hunt-capable act. The exact old held cases stay held. Q22B authorizes this branch qualification. Lethal-track return behavior is retained from the exact healing contract, not a new Pact immunity.

method: Separate read-only audit of serialized outputs, source text and native routes. Automated scoped predicates plus director scope reasoning below; numerical replay is not semantic proof. Not an independent human or runtime test.
readerCorrection: The initial event-kind-only audit omitted pulse0 contained in spell-manifestation. Corrected only the three audit predicates to read the exact existing five-entry pulseResults; no case, procedure or ruling altered.
